record.reason: DynamicRad uses static-ratio/dynamic-threshold sparse attention and an offline semantic-motion router for video diffusion; HunyuanVideo/Wan2.1 results claim 1.7–2.5x inference speedup and >80% sparsity. This is adjacent long-context/sparse-attention evidence but limited to video diffusion and specific block sizes/hardware.
record.title: DynamicRad: Content-Adaptive Sparse Attention for Long Video Diffusion
